verses.original: ה֣וֹי הַיֹּרְדִ֤ים מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה יִשָּׁעֵ֑נוּ עַל־ סוּסִ֖ים וַיִּבְטְח֨וּ עַל־ רָ֗ב רֶ֜כֶב כִּ֣י וְעַ֤ל מְאֹ֔ד עָצְמ֣וּ פָּֽרָשִׁים֙ כִּֽי־ וְלֹ֤א שָׁעוּ֙ עַל־ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ לֹ֥א דָרָֽשׁוּ׃ יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: hō·w hay·yō·rə·ḏîm miṣ·ra·yim lə·‘ez·rāh yiš·šā·‘ê·nū ‘al- sū·sîm way·yiḇ·ṭə·ḥū ‘al- rāḇ re·ḵeḇ kî wə·‘al mə·’ōḏ ‘ā·ṣə·mū pā·rā·šîm kî- wə·lō šā·‘ū ‘al- qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- lō ḏā·rā·šū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help who rely on horses who trust in their abundance of chariots . . . and in their multitude . . . of horsemen . . . They do not look to the Holy One of Israel - they do not seek the LORD

verses.original: ה֤וּא וְגַם־ חָכָם֙ וַיָּ֣בֵא רָ֔ע וְאֶת־ לֹ֣א הֵסִ֑יר דְּבָרָ֖יו וְקָם֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית מְרֵעִ֔ים וְעַל־ עֶזְרַ֖ת פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: hū wə·ḡam- ḥā·ḵām way·yā·ḇê rā‘ wə·’eṯ- lō hê·sîr də·ḇā·rāw wə·qām ‘al- bêṯ mə·rê·‘îm wə·‘al- ‘ez·raṯ pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Yet He too [is] wise and brings disaster - He does not call back His words He will rise up against the house of the wicked and against the allies of evildoers . . .

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֤יִם אָדָם֙ וְֽלֹא־ אֵ֔ל וְסוּסֵיהֶ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וְלֹא־ ר֑וּחַ וַֽיהוָ֞ה יַטֶּ֣ה יָד֗וֹ עוֹזֵר֙ וְכָשַׁ֤ל עָזֻ֔ר וְנָפַ֣ל כֻּלָּ֥ם יִכְלָיֽוּן׃ס וְיַחְדָּ֖ו
verses.transliteration: ū·miṣ·ra·yim ’ā·ḏām wə·lō- ’êl wə·sū·sê·hem bā·śār wə·lō- rū·aḥ Yah·weh yaṭ·ṭeh yā·ḏōw ‘ō·w·zêr wə·ḵā·šal ‘ā·zur wə·nā·p̄al kul·lām yiḵ·lā·yūn wə·yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: But the Egyptians are men not God their horses are flesh not spirit When the LORD stretches out His hand the helper will stumble and the one he helps will fall both will perish together

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה׀ אָֽמַר־ אֵלַ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הָאַרְיֵ֨ה יֶהְגֶּה֩ וְהַכְּפִ֜יר עַל־ טַרְפּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מְלֹ֣א רֹעִ֔ים יִקָּרֵ֤א עָלָיו֙ לֹ֣א יֵחָ֔ת מִקּוֹלָם֙ יַֽעֲנֶ֑ה וּמֵֽהֲמוֹנָ֖ם לֹ֣א כֵּ֗ן יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת יֵרֵד֙ לִצְבֹּ֥א עַל־ הַר־ צִיּ֖וֹן וְעַל־ גִּבְעָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar- ’ê·lay ka·’ă·šer hā·’ar·yêh yeh·geh wə·hak·kə·p̄îr ‘al- ṭar·pōw ’ă·šer mə·lō rō·‘îm yiq·qā·rê ‘ā·lāw lō yê·ḥāṯ miq·qō·w·lām ya·‘ă·neh ū·mê·hă·mō·w·nām lō kên Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yê·rêḏ liṣ·bō ‘al- har- ṣî·yō·wn wə·‘al- giḇ·‘ā·ṯāh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD has said to me Like a lion roaring or a young lion over its prey and though a band of shepherds is called out against it it is not terrified by their shouting or subdued by their clamor . . . so the LORD of Hosts will come down to do battle on Mount Zion [and] its heights

verses.original: כְּצִפֳּרִ֣ים עָפ֔וֹת כֵּ֗ן יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־ יָגֵ֛ן יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם גָּנ֥וֹן וְהִצִּ֖יל פָּסֹ֥חַ וְהִמְלִֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṣip·po·rîm ‘ā·p̄ō·wṯ kên Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘al- yā·ḡên yə·rū·šā·lim gā·nō·wn wə·hiṣ·ṣîl pā·sō·aḥ wə·him·lîṭ
verses.literal: Like birds hovering overhead so the LORD of Hosts . . . will protect Jerusalem He will shield it and deliver it He will pass over it and preserve it

verses.original: שׁ֗וּבוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֛ר הֶעְמִ֥יקוּ סָרָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šū·ḇū la·’ă·šer he‘·mî·qū sā·rāh bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Return to the One against whom you have so blatantly rebelled O children of Israel

verses.original: כִּ֚י הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם אִ֚ישׁ יִמְאָס֗וּן אֱלִילֵ֣י כַסְפּ֔וֹ וֶאֱלִילֵ֖י זְהָב֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לָכֶ֛ם יְדֵיכֶ֖ם חֵֽטְא׃ עָשׂ֥וּ
verses.transliteration: kî ha·hū bay·yō·wm ’îš yim·’ā·sūn ’ĕ·lî·lê ḵas·pōw we·’ĕ·lî·lê zə·hā·ḇōw ’ă·šer lā·ḵem yə·ḏê·ḵem ḥêṭ ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: For on that day every one of you will reject the idols of silver . . . and gold that your own hands have sinfully made

verses.original: אַשּׁוּר֙ וְנָפַ֤ל לֹא־ בְּחֶ֣רֶב אִ֔ישׁ וְחֶ֥רֶב תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֑נּוּ לֹֽא־ אָדָ֖ם וְנָ֥ס לוֹ֙ מִפְּנֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב וּבַחוּרָ֖יו יִהְיֽוּ׃ לָמַ֥ס
verses.transliteration: ’aš·šūr wə·nā·p̄al lō- bə·ḥe·reḇ ’îš wə·ḥe·reḇ tō·ḵă·len·nū lō- ’ā·ḏām wə·nās lōw mip·pə·nê- ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇa·ḥū·rāw yih·yū lā·mas
verses.literal: Then Assyria will fall but not by the sword of man a sword will devour them but not one made by mortals They will flee before the sword and their young men will be put to forced labor

verses.original: וְסַלְעוֹ֙ יַֽעֲב֔וֹר מִמָּג֣וֹר שָׂרָ֑יו וְחַתּ֥וּ מִנֵּ֖ס נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־ א֥וּר לוֹ֙ בְּצִיּ֔וֹן וְתַנּ֥וּר ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·sal·‘ōw ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr mim·mā·ḡō·wr śā·rāw wə·ḥat·tū min·nês nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ă·šer- ’ūr lōw bə·ṣî·yō·wn wə·ṯan·nūr lōw bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Their rock will pass away for fear and their princes will panic at [the sight of] the battle standard declares the LORD whose fire is in Zion whose furnace is in Jerusalem
